steps.name: Home with composer
steps.goal: Reach the demo Home screen with its project rail and the bottom composer. If a conversation is open, tap Back at the top left to return to Home. If the system Home screen is visible, tap the omg app icon. If an Apple Account Verification alert appears, tap Not Now. If an AI data consent screen appears, tap Agree and continue for this isolated demo fixture. Do not type into Message.
steps.done: The Home screen is visible with the bottom composer and its Attach a file button.

steps.name: Plus opens the native menu, composer stays
steps.goal: If an Apple Account Verification alert appears, tap Not Now first. Tap ONLY the element labelled Attach a file in the bottom composer, once.
steps.done: The system menu with Photo Library, Take Photo and Choose File is open next to the plus button. The composer field is still visible; it did not turn into the menu.

steps.name: Photo Library opens the picker
steps.goal: If an Apple Account Verification alert appears, tap Not Now first. Tap Photo Library in the open menu, once.
steps.done: The system photo picker is open, with a Cancel button.

steps.name: Cancel returns to the composer
steps.goal: If an Apple Account Verification alert appears, tap Not Now first. Tap Cancel in the photo picker.
steps.done: The picker is gone and the Home screen with the composer and its Attach a file button is back.

steps.name: Open a session
steps.goal: If an Apple Account Verification alert appears, tap Not Now first. If a menu is open, close it. Tap the session row titled Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window to open that conversation. The Home screen header says Welcome, You; the conversation screen does not.
steps.done: The conversation screen is open with its composer at the bottom and an Attach a file button in it.

steps.name: Session plus opens the native menu
steps.goal: If an Apple Account Verification alert appears, tap Not Now first. Tap ONLY the element labelled Attach a file in the conversation composer, once.
steps.done: The system menu with Photo Library, Take Photo and Choose File is open next to the plus button, and the composer is still visible.
